proposal.thesis: Cloudflare's Q2 FY2026 (company release 2026-08-06; quarter ended 2026-06-30) printed revenue of $696.1M, +36% YoY versus $512.32M a year earlier, beat the ~$665M Street number by 4.7%, and delivered non-GAAP EPS of $0.29 vs ~$0.27. Management raised FY2026 revenue to $2.864-2.870B and guided Q3 to $736-737M. Do not use the digest's 45.3% YoY figure — it conflicts with the sourced release, and I am citing the lower 36% number. The stock gapped on that print (11.8% up-gap seven sessions ago, 47% retained) and has since pulled back to the 20-day near $290: live $292.78 (alpaca_iex 2026-08-19 14:54 UTC) versus yesterday's $301.36 close. The 6-month chart reads no_supply_pullback on rvol 0.26 into that average — the one volume tell that survived its ablation — with 3-month relative strength still +45.2% vs SPY. The 31-analyst mean target is $333.55 (+13.8% from $293). This is a different demand_driver (software_platforms) from BKR (energy) and DXCM (healthcare), with 0.10 corr_to_book. I score it 0.57 because ownership_flow is institutions_selling_price_rising, ATM IV is 54% with a 6.26% 9-day expected move that sits on top of the 6.14% ATR stop floor, and Cloudflare issued $2.50B of 0% converts due 2031 on 2026-08-13 (8-K filed 2026-08-13: $259.5M of proceeds paid for capped calls; remainder for general corporate purposes — working capital, capex, debt repayment, potential M&A). Probe size is the honest answer to those three.

proposal.variant_perception: CONSENSUS: 31 analysts rate it a buy (mean 1.88) with a $333.55 target, +13.8% from the $292.78 2026-08-19 live print, and the Street is modeling ~32.5% forward revenue growth at a 174x forward P/E (bundle analyst_ratings / valuation). Headlines today still call the stock stretched after the post-print gap, and the $2.5B convert is being read as the company selling the multiple. MY VIEW: the 20-day throwback on no_supply_pullback is the market treating a 36% grower that just raised FY26 as if the move is done, while the Q3 $736-737M guide and the still-positive 3-month RS (+45.2%) say the post-print drift has not been paid. MECHANISM: Street NTM models are multiple-driven at 174x, so they fade any pause as 'the re-rate is complete.' What they underweight is the sequential: $696.1M going to $736-737M is still mid-30s growth with non-GAAP operating income $96.1M (13.8% of revenue) and TTM FCF $348M (digest, Q ended 2026-06-30). The 8-K filed 2026-08-13 and the 2026-08-11 pricing release disclose proceeds as $259.5M for capped calls plus the remainder for general corporate purposes (working capital, capex, debt repayment, potential M&A) — not a disclosed allocation to an AI-agent platform, and not a distressed issue. RESOLUTION: if NET has not closed above $310 (halfway to the $333.55 mean) by 2026-09-18, the post-print re-rate is not happening and I exit before the 2026-10-29 print rather than carry an ATR stop through that binary.
